description.en: Ten open-source plugins for DeepSeek Harness: an Agent Team board, local meeting minutes, Markdown and Mermaid preview, a sentence-level reading studio, local notes, phone remote control, plugin management, model prompt profiles, a desktop pet a chatbox companion and a video reader that transcribes, separates speakers and reads on-screen subtitles locally. They all run on your own machine.
description.zh: 十个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的开源插件：智能体团队看板、本地会议纪要、Markdown 与 Mermaid 预览、逐句精读工作台、本地笔记、手机远程控制、插件管理、模型提示词方案、桌面宠物与输入框伴侣（它同时负责本地转写、说话人分离与画面字幕识别），全部运行在你自己的机器上。

description.en: Read, render and edit the workspace files you are working on inside the chat: Markdown renders as GitHub-flavoured Markdown with Mermaid blocks drawn as real diagrams, HTML, SVG and images can be annotated and handed to the agent, videos play in the same panel, and a searchable, pinnable file tree opens any file next to the conversation.
description.zh: 在会话里直接读、渲染与编辑工作区文件：Markdown 按 GitHub 风格渲染，Mermaid 代码块画成真正的流程图，HTML、SVG 与图片可以框选标注后交给智能体，视频在同一个面板里播放，可搜索、可置顶的文件树让任何文件在对话旁边打开。

description.en: A local notes workspace with an always-on-top desktop float for quick capture. Notes support hierarchical tags, full-text search, random review, images, JSON backup, Markdown export and a thirty-day trash. The assistant reads and writes the same store.
description.zh: 本地笔记工作台，带一个始终置顶的桌面浮窗随时速记。支持层级标签、全文搜索、按天时间线、随机复习、图片附件、JSON 备份、Markdown 导出和 30 天回收站；智能体也能通过 memo 工具读写同一份笔记。

description.en: Local meeting minutes: record microphone and system audio, transcribe on-device, translate live side by side, then turn it into structured minutes and Q&A. Everything prefers local models, so text leaves the machine only when you pick a cloud endpoint.
description.zh: 本地会议纪要：同时录制麦克风与系统声音，端侧转写、实时双语对照翻译，会议结束自动生成结构化纪要与问答。转写、纪要与翻译默认走本机模型，只有主动选择云端端点时文本才会离开本机。

description.en: Import EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown or HTML, then practise sentence by sentence: synced read-aloud, typing along the text, word-by-word comparison of your own voice, vocabulary with spaced review, and a chapter turned into a mind map or a two-voice podcast.
description.zh: 面向中英文书的逐句精读工作台：导入 EPUB、PDF、TXT、Markdown 或 HTML 后，可听朗读、跟读打字、朗读后与原文逐词比对，把生词收进带间隔复习的生词本，还能把当前章节生成思维导图或双人对话播客。

description.en: A Team Board tab beside Trajectory shows how an Agent Team is cooperating: one column per teammate with shared tasks, status counts, token cost and the files they produced. Click an avatar for a member panel covering duty, artifacts, workload and spend.
description.zh: 在 Trajectory 旁新增「团队看板」页签，显示智能体团队如何协作：一列一个队友，列出共享任务、待办/进行中/完成计数、token 成本与实际产出的文件。点开头像可打开成员面板，查看职责、产物、工作量与消耗。

description.en: Drive the DeepSeek Harness agent from your phone. Scan the QR code in Settings or open the access link, and the phone loads the web app through a relay tunnel, so sessions, streaming output and tool approvals behave as on desktop. Devices can be revoked.
description.zh: 用手机远程操控本机的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。在设置页扫二维码或打开访问链接，手机通过中继隧道加载真实的网页应用：会话、流式输出、工具审批和输入框与桌面端一致。可随时吊销已授权设备，宿主不会对公网开放入站端口。

description.en: A transparent desktop pet inside DeepSeek Harness: a hundred plus looping animations, multiple pets at once, click and drag physics, chatter and chat, session-aware work animations, to-do reminders, system notifications. Browser overlay or native window.
description.zh: 住在 DeepSeek Harness 里的透明桌面宠物：一百余段动画、可多开同屏、大小与位置可配，点击会 Q 弹、拖拽能甩抛，还有碎碎念与对话、跟随会话切换的工作状态动画、待办提醒和系统通知。可跑在网页浮层，也能住进桌面置顶小窗。

description.en: Extends the Plugins page with an Updates tab listing every installed plugin that has a newer version, its release notes and a one-click upgrade, plus an update badge beside each title. A Share button exports a plugin to another profile.
description.zh: 在插件页新增「更新」页签，列出所有已安装插件中可升级的版本、发布说明与一键升级按钮，并在插件标题旁显示更新角标；插件详情页的「分享」按钮还能把插件导出给另一个 profile。

description.en: Replace the system prompt the Harness injects into a model: ready-made prompt sets, a per-model switch, and a default set for Chinese models. A drill console is limited to loopback and private-network targets, to tell a host-policy block from a model refusal.
description.zh: 可替换 DeepSeek Harness 注入给模型的系统提示词，内置多套提示词方案并支持按模型切换，默认方案面向国产模型。演练台只允许回环与内网靶场，用来分辨宿主策略拦截和模型本身拒答。支持的宿主版本各不相同，安装前请先看仓库 README。

description.en: A Pikachu pinned to the composer's top-right. Idle most of the time, it moves only when the agent's work state changes — and a finished task, a stopped one and a failed one each get their own clip and sound. Call it by name in the composer (no send) and it answers; right-click to make it say a line you give it, keep the lines it said before, bring up something from your memory / meeting minutes / reading shelf / moments, or play one of 17 animations. The prompt booster ships in the same bundle as a second, independently toggleable feature. A merge chip also folds 2–8 queued follow-ups into one coherent message while the agent is busy. The same bundle now reads videos: hand it a file or a YouTube / X / Bilibili link and it returns a timestamped transcript with speaker labels, OCR'd on-screen subtitles and keyframes, all locally. Four of its quick actions are real workbenches: local audio transcription, writing drafts, a .pptx deck generator, and a video reader instruction. Its quick-actions panel also has a translator: type, speak or drop a PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD/HTML, translate with your own model, and keep words and sentences in a favourite book with search and Markdown export.
description.zh: 挂在输入框右上角的皮卡丘。大部分时间安静待着，只在智能体工作状态变化时动一下，并且「完成 / 被中止 / 失败」三种结局各有自己的动作与音效。在输入框里喊它的名字（不用发送）它会回应；右键可以让它说指定的话、记住说过的台词、从你的记忆 / 会议纪要 / 读书 / 随手记里挑一件事说出来，或者播放 17 个动作之一。提示词增强作为第二个可独立开关的功能合在同一个 bundle 里。 智能体忙的时候，还能把 2–8 条排队消息合并成一条完整请求同一个 bundle 现在还能看视频：传文件或贴 YouTube / X / Bilibili 链接，返回带时间码与说话人标签的转写、画面烧录字幕（OCR）与关键帧，全部在本机完成快捷功能里已经有四个真工作台：本机录音转写、写作草稿、.pptx 生成与视频理解指令快捷键面板里还有翻译：文字、语音、文件（PDF/DOCX/TXT/MD/HTML）都能翻，译文可存入收藏本当生词本，支持搜索与导出。
